scope: Complete golden observer CLI port. Coax owns options and Number/query/HTML semantics, anchored instrumentation, route configuration, exact CDP order and readiness, fixed frame steps, all deadlines and Runtime/Log verdicts, byte ranges/POST identity/assembly, producer-input-source joins, reuse and raw difference counters. JavaScript performs browser SDK and typed-array/hash/HTTP effects only.

original.retirement: After same-input controls, archive readback and source-byte verification; no runnable TypeScript copy remains in the repository.

checks_first.note: Parser/transport checks precede their implementations. Failed rounds and every survivor remain in the archive; none was waived.

authority.scope: Each owned policy's root procedures; dependency checks retained.
authority.numeric_correction: A peer review found low-limit radix parsing could accept 0x5 for limit4 through negative division truncation. Coax now admits the bounded accumulated value after each digit; binary/octal/hex controls and final 367/367 mutation qualification cover it.

controls.reuse_generic_and_legacy: Both pass, copying the historical receipt unchanged. Their obsolete observer source paths are not reopened or promoted to current-source evidence.
controls.corrupt_artifact: Changed GPU byte with unchanged receipt SHA refuses exit1 before capture.
controls.image_difference_is_diagnostic: A correctly rehashed reused image differing in one raw channel gives original and Coax exit0, identical=false, exactly one differing channel/group-of-four and max delta1. Every comparison field and raw artifact agrees.
controls.runtime_exception: Actual browser exception gives original and Coax exit1 with nonempty raw exceptions; default90 frames exercised.
controls.log_error: Actual missing-image network error gives original and Coax exit1 with nonempty error-level Log entries; default90 frames exercised.
controls.override_routing: Ten complete HTTP bodies: scene/particle override selection, instrumented host, supplied producer and package manifest across legacy/generic. Every body SHA matches its exact selected file; final origin/source ownership passes.
controls.fresh_output_guard: Nonempty output containing the supplied producer at observed-host.js refuses exit2 before writing and preserves the Wasm SHA. The final image's fresh generic route plus frozen legacy reuse matches every retained original field and artifact.
controls.cli_boundaries: Pure checks cover first occurrence/unknown controls, frames1..600 including decimal/exponent/radix/Unicode whitespace/IEEE midpoint spellings, arbitrary leading zero viewport digits, malformed/missing/conflicting controls, exact URLSearchParams byte behavior, first/global HTML transforms and anchored capacity failures.
controls.transport_boundaries: Zero bytes, exact64MiB edges, eight chunks through512MiB, invalid spans, typed status/count/path/file/hash/publication/cleanup acknowledgement fields, and every reuse control are mutation-qualified. Actual captures transfer eight artifacts per full two-route comparison through declared binary POST sinks.

provenance.compiler_scope: Explicit qualified older compiler for observer tooling only. No current-main compiler publication or new product emission claim.
provenance.source_readback: observing-source.sha256 plus observing-relative.sha256 and final-source.sha256 independently check every absolute and relative repository path stamped by the respective capture receipt; all readbacks pass. The observing entry's exact pre-guard bytes are recovered by removing only that one later line and must match both stamped aliases. Actual images, linked native C/H, browser effects, source graph, raw event/counter diagnostics and supplied small products are retained.
provenance.browser: Muted headless Chrome, exact original three background flags, no launcher window-size override, explicit device metrics. Raw version/argv-related CDP records remain in each epoch.

retained_red: First Coax capture assembled every raw artifact but attempted to serialize absent legacy render status; invalid receipt and valid failure/raw ledger remain as diagnosis only. The corrected observing image passed exact frozen-input comparison.

The first qualification helper double-quoted a patched receipt hash, so the intended changed-image case correctly refused malformed JSON. Corrected v2 preserves the earlier red and proves original/Coax diagnostic parity without repeating the passing other cases.

The initial routing verifier reused the shared64KiB GET helper for a101408-byte shader. Its incomplete-read failure is retained. A qualifier-local bounded1MiB receiver then checks all ten complete bodies and selected hashes; shared RTO behavior was unchanged.

The final nonempty-output safeguard was added after read-only review. Earlier captures retain their exact older source/image epoch; only the changed guard and necessary fresh capture were requalified.
limits: Small frozen fixture realm only; no new shader/producer/package build, full Grid gate or renderer arithmetic claim.
Shared CDP/RTO POST and idle-WebSocket effects have separate qualification; this tool consumes those stable APIs and retains final ledgers. It never suppresses Runtime/Log failures.

Canonical historical artifact leaves are required; malformed physical capture extents are refused. Reused receipts are integrity-checked local evidence, not authentication against a caller fabricating an entire receipt and hashes.
Exact raw counters retain the original grouping of four bytes even for an RGBA16F image; this observer does not reinterpret channel values or apply a floating tolerance.
Original180s total browser budget, 60s warmup, 200x25ms readback polls and30s per-CDP deadline remain bounded. Cleanup is awaited separately.
